title: The Evaluation Substrate Matters: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Serving Substrates
abstract: arXiv:2611.28671v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) usually coordinate heterogeneous models and tools to solve complex tasks, creating a growing need for reliable evaluation. However, a multi-agent workflow that is fastest in one serving environment can lose its advantage in another, even when its models, prompts, and task remain fixed. This makes a benchmark result conditional on how the workflow is executed. We introduce MASSys, a benchmark for measuring this dependence in multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems. MASSys executes the same candidate-task pairs across serving substrates and load regimes, using five workload families spanning software repair, research synthesis, financial analysis, interactive control, and diagram generation. It records task quality alongside delivery, latency, cost, resource pressure, and failure evidence. In a controlled motivation diagnostic, the Star workflow falls from first to fourth in mean-latency rank under KV-cac

translated_title: 评估基底至关重要：多智能体服务基底基准测试
translated_abstract: 多智能体系统（MAS）通常通过协调异构的模型和工具来解决复杂任务，这带来了对可靠评估日益增长的需求。然而，在某个服务环境中运行最快的多智能体工作流，在另一个环境中可能会失去其优势，即使其模型、提示词和任务均保持不变。这使得基准测试的结果取决于工作流是如何被执行的。我们提出了MASSys，一个用于衡量多智能体大语言模型（LLM）系统中这种依赖性的基准。MASSys在跨不同服务基底和负载情形下执行相同的候选方案-任务配对，使用五个工作负载族，涵盖软件修复、研究综合、金融分析、交互式控制和图表生成。它同时记录任务质量以及交付表现、延迟、成本、资源压力和失败证据。在一项受控的动机诊断实验中，Star工作流在KV缓存条件下的平均延迟排名从第一名跌至第四名……
tldr: 论文提出MASSys基准，首次系统量化了多智能体LLM系统性能对底层服务基底与负载环境的依赖性，揭示了同一工作流在不同执行环境下的性能排名可能发生显著变化。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces MASSys, a benchmark that systematically quantifies how multi-agent LLM system performance depends on serving substrates and load regimes, revealing that the same workflow's performance ranking can shift dramatically across execution environments.
